text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Nakayama Racecourse has<n>drawn a far larger
crowd than it did<n>last year—indeed, perhaps the
largest<n>in racing history.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Today, Maruzensky the Beast and<n>Symboli Rudolf
the Emperor will hold<n>a showdown for the ages.
Everyone<n>is here to see history in the making.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: And amidst the crowd's cheers...
Look out! Coming through!
Hey, stop that! You can't just push<n>your way in!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Check it out! This place is packed!And it's still so early!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I think... I might take a rest... Just<n>getting inside
was quite a trial...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, McQueen! Where's that<n>endurance?
Aren't you supposed to<n>be a stayer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Only on the track, not in heaving<n>crowds!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I've ever seen so many<n>people. And
besides...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Can you believe it? We're gonna getto see the Maruzensky race theSymboli Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Who will win, the Beast or the<n>Emperor? I'm
gonna tell my<n>grandkids about this race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is packed with<n>outstanding
racers, but Maruzen and<n>the President are all
anyone can talk<n>about.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I've never seen a crowd so<n>enthusiastic.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, 'cause they're just that good!<n>Aw man, I
can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm not gonna miss a single second!These eyes of mine are gonna seehow the Symboli Rudolf wins herraces!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As time goes on and excitement<n>swells in the
stands...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I suppose this is it. I'll see you later,<n>Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I was just wondering if that was all<n>you had to
say.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Both the media and the fans are<n>calling this race a
battle for the ages.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Should you not offer a little more<n>encouragement
to your trainee?
choice_data_list: You already know everything I could say.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hah... I suppose I do.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. For entrusting me<n>with your
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well then, once more... I'll see you<n>later.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hello there, Maruzensky. It's been a<n>while.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It sure has. I feel like we never get to<n>see each
other.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Although, that said...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Go Maruzeeen! Go Rudooolf!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, just listen to them. They're all<n>itching to
watch us race.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Will the Emperor vanquish the Beast,<n>or will the
Beast gobble her up,<n>crowns and all? ♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see the Beast's all fired up. The<n>perfect quarry
for the Emperor to<n>display her gallantry.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Will the Emperor vanquish the Beast,<n>you say? ...I
like the sound of that. It<n>might just be time for a
hunt.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yikes. What happened to our kind and<n>caring
President? You sound<n>downright bloodthirsty.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ambition is savage by nature. And<n>besides...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm under strict instructions to be my<n>real self
today. I hope that doesn't<n>disappoint you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Not at all!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It just makes me want to gobble you<n>up even
more! ♪ Hehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead and try. I'll drive my sword<n>through
your flank and leave you in<n>the dust!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! Let's get this started!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Our audience is waiting for us.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Let's give them the performance of a<n>lifetime.
